_source: Request side of the Higgsfield connector's tool definitions as served to the agent on 2026-10-01 (the bot runs these; the CLI writes the request file). Names, required keys and limits copied from the live schemas; descriptions shortened.

params.get_cost: If true, return the cost in credits for this generation without submitting any job.
params.use_unlim: OMIT IT to let the server decide - if the caller holds an allowance the tool submits nothing and returns `unlim_choice`, the question to put to the user; answer by calling again with the same params plus this field.

medias_item.value: UUID from media_upload/media_import_url or job_id from a prior generation. Do not pass https:// URLs here.

model_params_used_by_slop._note: model-specific keys (allowed by additional_properties) that the production seedance_2_5 requests used
